findings.issue: Glossary freezes Ethereal Diapason as النغم الأثيري (Eredrim ability); this row transliterates it instead.

findings.source_en: Eredrim smashes his Diapason to create a blinding shockwave that deals <Break>Break Damage</> to all enemies in range.
findings.ar: يضرب إردريم ديابازونه فيولّد موجة صدمية خاطفة للأبصار تُلحق <Break>ضرر الكَسر</> بكل عدو في المدى.
findings.issue: Same frozen term as the ability name above: Diapason is transliterated ديابازونه here, so the description does not match the ability it describes.
findings.suggested_ar: يضرب إردريم نغمه الأثيري فيولّد موجة صدمية خاطفة للأبصار تُلحق <Break>ضرر الكَسر</> بكل عدو في المدى.

findings.issue: Glossary freezes Execution as الإجهاز and explicitly rejects the capital-punishment sense (الإعدام); الجلّاد is that rejected sense, and it clashes with this passive's own description, which renders 'executes enemies' as يُجهز.
Glossary freezes New Game+ as اللعبة الجديدة+ with no space before the plus; this row drops the article and inserts a space, which also risks the + detaching in RTL layout.
